interest: Reveals Allied policies balancing atomic research prohibitions with releasing bomb casualty data and permitting medical radioisotope imports.
keywords: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
overview: This file documents the formulation and enforcement of Allied occupation policy regarding Japanese scientific research in atomic energy between September 1946 and April 1949. Central to the records is Far Eastern Commission policy decision FEC-024/6 and SCAP Directive Serial No. 67, which established a comprehensive ban on fundamental and applied atomic energy research and development in Japan following SWNCC reviews. The collection also details interagency deliberations concerning the public release of Japanese casualty and damage studies on atomic bomb effects, alongside procedures established among the State Department, Army, SCAP, and the Atomic Energy Commission permitting the strictly monitored importation of radioisotopes for peaceful medical and scientific purposes.
